title: 第十五章 刺杀第十六章 变异了
slug: 末世大佬穿星际四个竹马悔哭了
content_zh:
06是个职业杀手。
一个月前，他接到了暗杀唐斩月的单子，用了三天调查目标信息：天生体弱，在精神体二次觉醒前就是个废物。
如今就算觉醒了，顶多也就升两级。
嗯，再严谨一点，算三级，从f升到c级，也还是个废物。
06将这次任务打上了简单的标签，却不想单蹲人就蹲了一个月。
唐斩月生活太单调了，大部分时间都在联邦军校，他根本进不去。偶尔出来，身边还跟着叶峥。
好不容易今天唐斩月独自一人，本以为手到擒来，却又发生了出乎他意料的事。
唐斩月竟然躲开了那一刀。
06瞬间反应过来，情报出错了。
已经转身离开的他不得不暴露自己，逆着人群冲向唐斩月。
过了今天，再找机会就难了。
唐斩月转身便锁定了06，她眉梢微挑，对吓傻了的导购小姐笑了笑，“找个安全的地方躲好。”
导购小姐回神，下意识蹲到柜台后面，带着哭腔道：“你快进来！店里的警报已经被触发了，督星办的人很快就会到。”
说完她才反应过来，店里的能量防护罩并没有开启。
导购小姐：……还让不让人活了！
唐斩月也发现了，无奈，她只能挡在柜台前，青莲顺势而出，冲向06。
06觉得好笑，女人的精神体能干什么？放出来安抚他，让他下手轻一点吗？他可不是怜香惜玉的人。
淡灰色的精神力弥漫而出，在他体外化作一头灰色巨狼，高三米多，站直了几乎要顶到天花板。
巴掌大小的青莲跟灰狼比起来，就像个小朋友的玩具。
这下不仅导购小姐，离老远围观的人都不忍心看下去了，好像下一秒就要有人血溅当场。

当然，他们猜的也没错，只是对象错了。
青莲在狼爪挥来的瞬间，忽然膨胀变大，原本温和的淡青色精神力中混进去大片猩红，淡淡的煞气弥漫开来，轻而易举地挡住狼爪攻击。
几乎同时，青红色的精神力凝聚成道道光刃，暴雨般袭向巨狼。
巨狼怒吼，凝聚出精神力屏障抵挡，却小看了光刃的力量，反被密集的攻击打得不断后退。
06心头巨震，精神体二次觉醒，还能让人从安抚系变成战斗系？这种匪夷所思的事，他从没听说过！
06深吸一口气，闪身绕过巨狼和青莲，冲向躲在后方的唐斩月。
精神体可以通过觉醒在短时间内变强，但人的身手和战斗经验却是日积月累的，只要让他近身……
“叮”的一声，06挥出去的匕首被唐斩月轻易挡下，用的还是他之前扔出去的那把。
06眼睛瞪大，不信邪地快速挥出匕首。
一时间“叮叮叮”的声音不绝于耳，所有攻击都被挡了下来。
06不敢相信，三观都要崩了，他大吼一声，匕首对着唐斩月的咽喉划去。
唐斩月身体微微后仰，差之毫厘的躲开锋利的匕首，同时一脚踹出。
06本能后退，与她拉开距离，随后不等他再攻上去，唐斩月的身影便如鬼魅般出现在他身后。
06瞳孔猛然一缩，糟了！
唐斩月唇角微勾，“一路走好。”
下一秒，匕首在06的咽喉处一划而过。
06瞬间倒地，顺势往前一滚，与唐斩月拉开距离。
content_en:
06 is a professional killer.
A month ago, he received the order to assassinate Tang Zhanyue and spent three days investigating the target information: he was born weak and was a waste before the second awakening of his spiritual body.
Even if he awakens now, he will only be promoted to two levels at most.
Well, to be more rigorous, even if you count it as level 3, after being promoted from level F to level C, it is still a waste.
06 labeled this mission as simple, but he didn’t want to squat alone for a month.
Tang Zhanyue's life was too monotonous. He spent most of his time at the Federal Military Academy, and he couldn't get into it at all. Occasionally, he would come out with Ye Zheng by his side.
Finally, Tang Zhanyue was alone today. He thought he would be able to catch him, but something unexpected happened.
Tang Zhanyue actually dodged the knife.
06 reacted instantly, the information was wrong.
Having turned around to leave, he had no choice but to expose himself and rush towards Tang Zhanyue against the crowd.
After today, it will be difficult to find another opportunity.
Tang Zhanyue turned around and locked onto 06. She raised her eyebrows slightly and smiled at the frightened shopping guide, "Find a safe place to hide."
The shopping guide girl came to her senses, squatted down behind the counter subconsciously, and said in a tearful tone: "Come in quickly! The alarm in the store has been triggered, and the people from the Supervisory Office will be here soon."
After saying that, she realized that the energy shield in the store was not turned on.
Shopping guide lady: ...I can’t let anyone live anymore!
Tang Zhanyue also discovered it, but she had no choice but to block in front of the counter. Qinglian took advantage of the situation and rushed towards 06.
06 I think it’s funny, what can a woman’s mental body do? Release it to comfort him and ask him to be gentler? He is not a pity person.
Light gray mental power filled the air and transformed into a giant gray wolf outside his body. He was more than three meters tall and almost reached the ceiling when he stood up straight.
Compared with the gray wolf, the palm-sized Qinglian looks like a child's toy.
Now not only the shopping guide, but also the people watching from afar couldn't bear to watch anymore. It seemed that blood would be splashed on the spot in the next second.
Of course, their guess was correct, but the target was wrong.
The moment Qinglian swung the wolf's claws, it suddenly expanded and became larger. A large amount of scarlet was mixed into the originally gentle light cyan spiritual power, and a faint evil aura filled the air, easily blocking the attack of the wolf's claws.
Almost at the same time, the blue-red mental power condensed into blades of light, attacking the giant wolf like a rainstorm.
The giant wolf roared angrily, condensing a mental barrier to resist, but underestimated the power of the light blade, and was pushed back continuously by the intensive attacks.
06 A huge shock in the heart, the second awakening of the spiritual body, can it still make people change from the comfort system to the combat system? He had never heard of such an incredible thing!
06 took a deep breath, ducked around the giant wolf and Qinglian, and rushed towards Tang Zhanyue who was hiding behind.
The spiritual body can become stronger in a short period of time through awakening, but a person's skills and combat experience are accumulated over time. As long as he gets close...
With a "ding" sound, the dagger swung by 06 was easily blocked by Tang Zhanyue, using the same one he threw before.
06's eyes widened, and he quickly swung the dagger in disbelief.
For a while, the sound of "ding, ding, ding" was heard, and all attacks were blocked.
06 He couldn't believe it. His three views were about to collapse. He roared and slashed Tang Zhanyue's throat with the dagger.
Tang Zhanyue leaned back slightly, narrowly avoiding the sharp dagger, and kicked it out at the same time.
06 instinctively retreated and distanced herself from her, and then before he could attack again, Tang Zhanyue's figure appeared behind him like a ghost.
06The pupils suddenly shrank, terrible!
Tang Zhanyue's lips curled up slightly, "Have a good trip."
The next second, the dagger swiped across 06's throat.
06 fell to the ground instantly, rolled forward, and distanced himself from Tang Zhanyue.
